column1: # Core Turkish irregulars the two oracles' overlap does not attest, so no
# agreement exists to mine them (gitmek and etmek are absent from UniMorph
# tur; tatmak and yemek from the shared set). Supplied by hand from the
# standard grammar; merged by scripts/tur/mine_verbs.py, where a manual
# row wins over anything mined for the same lemma.
